name: blotato
description: Publish and schedule posts to X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky and Pinterest through Blotato's hosted MCP server. Maintained by hachiflow, not by Blotato.

tools.name: read_accounts
tools.description: See which social accounts are connected, and the posts and schedules on them.

tools.name: publish
tools.description: Publish posts now or schedule them, on the accounts you connected.

tools.name: comments
tools.description: Read comments on posts, and reply to them.

tools.name: messages
tools.description: Read direct messages and send replies.

tools.name: create_media
tools.description: Make images and videos, and pull content from a link, to use in posts.

tools.name: automations
tools.description: Create and change automatic replies to direct messages.

BLOTATO_API_KEY.title: Blotato API key
BLOTATO_API_KEY.description: From Blotato, Settings, API. Creating a key starts the paid Starter plan; the free trial has no API or MCP access.
